principles: Nguon goc va nguon chinh thuc co quyen cao hon implementation.
Thu vien pho bien chi dung de cross-check, khong tu tao chan ly.
Hai implementation cung tac gia/he sinh thai khong duoc tinh la hai nguon doc lap.
Bat dong phai duoc ghi nhan, khong am tham chon mot ket qua.
Heuristic phai gan nhan EXPERIMENTAL va AI khong duoc trinh bay nhu quy tac co dien da xac minh.

PRIMARY_FAMILY.label: Dung nguyen dien, locator moi o cap quyen/muc

OFFICIAL_SECONDARY.label: Nguon co quan chinh thuc / luu tru

confidencePolicy.high: Nguon thien van chinh thuc; hoac PRIMARY_EXACT/OFFICIAL_SECONDARY kem cross-check khong co dispute.
confidencePolicy.medium: PRIMARY_FAMILY hoac nhieu implementation dong thuan nhung chua co locator nguyen dien chinh xac.
confidencePolicy.low: Chi co implementation, heuristic, hoac co bat dong chua giai quyet.
confidencePolicy.disputed: Bat ky cross-check quan trong nao mau thuan voi engine; AI phai noi ro chua du can cu.
